rows.name: Hastings
rows.description: On West Hill, in one, N.N.E., 508 ft. apart, to direct the fishermen (Sept. 29 to Mar. 25)... A green light on the pier........

rows.name: R. SOVEREIGN SHOALS
rows.description: In 12 fms., S. Ely, 2 miles from R. Sovereign buoy. Shows 3 flashes in 23 secs., at intervals of 37 secs. Small ball over usual masthead ball. Gong. Warning-gun..............

rows.name: Eastbourne
rows.description: A green light is shown on the pier, and two red lights on the beach..............................

rows.name: BEACHY HEAD
rows.description: A white lighthouse, 47 ft. high, on summit of Belletout Cliff. From the eastward the lt. will open when bearing N.W. ¾ W., and by keeping it so will lead 1¼ mile outside Royal Sovereign Shoals ..................................

rows.name: Newhaven
rows.character: One br. fix. lt. and Tide Light Green light on E. pier
rows.description: On West pier-head. Tide lt. below main lt. red betw. 10 and 13 ft., bright betw. 13 and 15 ft., and green above 15 ft. .....................

rows.name: Shoreham Harbour
rows.character: One bright fixed light, and Tide Light Two green lights
rows.description: Tide lt. on central pier, green while 8 to 11 ft., bright while 11 ft. and over, and red at high water; bears S. by W. ½ W. from upper lt. Two green lts., one on E., one on W. pier-head. Approaching, keep high br. lt. open E. of W. pier green lt., and when clear of W. pier-head, keep near the pier until high lt. and tide light come in line .......................

rows.name: Littlehampton
rows.character: Red lt. on E. pier, N. end
rows.description: Also tide lts. on S. end of pier; white 10 feet, green 11 ft., red 12 ft., red & white 13 ft., two white 14 ft., white & green 15 feet, till H.W.

rows.name: OWERS LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: On the S.E. end of the Owers Shoal, in 19 fms. Flashes twice bright, once red. Fog Trumpet 6 blasts every minute. Warning Gun ......

rows.name: Nab Lightvessel
rows.description: Near New Grounds; must be passed to eastward. Gong; Warning Gun ..................

rows.name: ST. CATHERINE'S PT.
rows.description: Stone tower, reduced in height in 1875. Lt. vis. between E. ⅞ S. and N.W. ½ W. Fog Trumpet, 2 blasts every 4 minutes ............

rows.name: Warner Lightvessel
rows.description: In 13 fms., on the eastern part of the shoal. Gong; Warning Gun .............................

rows.name: SPITHEAD
rows.description: Green lt. on fort at Brading Haven; red lt. on fort on No Man's Land; white lt. on fort on Horse Sand; red lt. on fort on Spit Sand ...

rows.name: Stokes Bay Pier
rows.description: Red lights on East and West ends ...............

rows.name: Southsea Castle
rows.description: Shows red in channel between Spit Refuge Buoy and Horse Fort, or to betw. S. by W. and S.W. by S. It is green to West of the Spit Buoy betw. S.W. by S. and W. ¼ S. ...

rows.name: Southsea
rows.description: Two red lights on Clarence Esplanade Pier ...

rows.name: Portsmouth Dockyard
rows.character: One fixed red or green light
rows.description: On S. end of S. railway jetty. Shows red betw. the eastern side of the harbour and S.E. tangent of Block House fort, and green westward of that line. Harbour railway works will be cleared by keeping in green light ...

rows.name: Calshot Lightvessel
rows.description: Off Calshot Castle, in 3½ fathoms. Gong; Warning-gun ..........................................

rows.name: Netley Pier
rows.description: One fixed green light to be shown ...........

rows.name: Southampton
rows.character: 1. Two fixed red lts. 2. Two fix. green lts. 3. One fixed red lt. 4. Two fix. bright lts.
rows.description: 1. On either side of entrance to Docks. In one N.N.E. ¾ E. lead up River Itchen in 15 ft.... 2. On Extension Quay, N.W. side of R. Itchen 3. From Harpy lt.-ves., at entr. of Riv. Itchen 4. From iron posts on Royal Pier, 15 yards apart. In one lead up channel ..................
